configurePresets.name: web
configurePresets.displayName: Web / WASM (emscripten; GLES3 -> WebGL2, one page per example that has one)
configurePresets.description: Needs the Emscripten SDK ACTIVATED, not merely installed: `source /path/to/emsdk/emsdk_env.sh` sets $EMSDK, and this preset resolves the toolchain through it. Without that the configure fails on an unreadable toolchain file rather than on anything to do with RayClay.

buildPresets.name: default
buildPresets.description: Every build preset carries an explicit `jobs`. WHY: with the Unix Makefiles generator a bare `--parallel` passes `make -j` with NO argument, which is UNBOUNDED - it is NOT one job per core. Make then spawns every recipe the dependency graph allows, which has OOM-frozen a 30 GB machine. CAVEAT: `jobs` is honoured only by `cmake --build --preset <name>`; it is BYPASSED by `cmake --build <dir> --parallel`, so pass an explicit count with the directory form.
